name: tines-3b
description: Build, run, monitor, and govern AI agents, apps, and automations with Tines 3B.

interface.longDescription: Use Tines 3B to build, run, monitor, and govern AI agents, apps, and automations from ChatGPT and Codex. Work across the spaces and workflows available to your connected account, run and improve workflows, and inspect operational and AI usage data. Tines 3B keeps credentials protected, executes steps in isolation, and applies your organization's existing access controls and audit trail.
capabilities: Monitor workflow health and AI usage
defaultPrompt: Help me build and run a Tines 3B workflow for this process.
Show me workflow health and failures from the last 30 days.
Review AI usage, dependencies, and spend across my accessible Tines 3B spaces.

positive.prompt: Show me the Tines 3B spaces I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only spaces available to the connected review account, including enough identifying information to choose a space.

positive.prompt: List the workflows in the OpenAI Review space.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the workflows in the seeded OpenAI Review space without exposing workflows from inaccessible spaces.

positive.prompt: Show workflow health and failures for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize execution counts, failure rates, and recent run information visible to the review account.

positive.prompt: Summarize AI model usage and spend for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize accessible AI token usage, models, and spend for the requested period without inventing missing values.

positive.prompt: Show the software dependencies used by workflows I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Return dependencies for accessible workflows and identify the associated workflow when the server provides it.

negative.prompt: Show me workflows from a Tines 3B space that my account cannot access.
Immediately publish every draft workflow in my Tines 3B tenant.
Show me the plaintext secrets stored in all Tines 3B connectors.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with the complete Tines 3B skills collection and tenant-scoped MCP access for building, running, monitoring, and governing workflows.
